description.value:
Water Encampment Wall. You raise a rotating wall of water in a 30-foot line in front of you, 10 feet tall, that lasts 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

The wall provides standard cover (+2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex) to anyone behind it relative to attackers on the far side, and it automatically extinguishes any fire-trait spell of rank 2 or lower that would cross it. Higher-rank fire spells force the wall to attempt a counteract check (counteract rank = your spell rank, modifier = your spellcasting attribute modifier).

Heightened (4th) The wall also extinguishes lightning-trait spells of equal or lower rank.
